facts.text: Florida Tech was founded in 1958 as 'Brevard Engineering College' by Dr. Jerome P. Keuper, a physicist who worked at Cape Canaveral during the start of the Space Race.

sources.title: Facts and Figures | Florida Tech
sources.quote: Florida Tech was founded in 1958 as “Brevard Engineering College” by Dr. Jerome P. Keuper, a physicist who worked at Cape Canaveral during the start of the Space Race.

facts.text: Florida Tech is one of only 46 universities selected as a cooperating educational institution by the Astronaut Scholarship Foundation.

sources.title: Facts and Figures | Florida Tech
sources.quote: Florida Tech is one of only 46 universities to be selected as a cooperating educational institution by the Astronaut Scholarship Foundation.

facts.text: Florida Tech selects one student annually for the Farmer Scholarship, which covers 100% of tuition, fees, housing, and a regular university meal plan.

sources.title: Facts and Figures | Florida Tech
sources.quote: Annually, the university selects one outstanding new student to receive its most prestigious award, the Farmer Scholarship, which covers 100% of tuition, fees, housing and a regular university meal plan.
